briefings.title: IonQ to buy cybersecurity firm for up to $1.3B
briefings.tldr: IonQ CEO Niccolo de Masi discussed the company's acquisition strategy—including the purchase of cybersecurity firm Elisity—to bolster its defense-in-depth posture against accelerating quantum and AI-driven cybersecurity threats.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari
briefings.tldr: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari noted that while consumer resilience continues to surprise the Fed, inflation remains too high at approximately 3% and requires continued vigilance.

briefings.title: Inside the Urgent Effort to Prepare America’s Workforce for a Massive AI Disruption
briefings.tldr: Former U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo leads the new organization RAISE US to prevent severe economic and gender inequality from AI disruption by partnering with state governors and business leaders on career transition pilots.

briefings.title: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari on the outlook, rates and monetary policy — 9/30/2026
briefings.tldr: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari stated that inflation remains too high at around 3% and noted that the U.S. economy's resilience continues to surprise him, leading him to question how tight monetary policy actually is.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's interview with Citadel's Ken Griffin and Carnegie Mellon Univ. Pres. Farnam Jahanian
briefings.tldr: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin announced a historic $3 billion investment in Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) alongside President Farnam Jahanian, aimed at reshaping higher education and establishing a new integrated campus model in Miami focused on societal grand challenges.

briefings.title: Property Play: How the CEO of mortgage tech firm Blend revived his business after disaster
briefings.tldr: Following a painful post-IPO downturn and a strategic pivot to profitability, Blend CEO Nima Ghamsari is betting on agentic AI to reinvent mortgage underwriting and eliminate administrative friction.

briefings.title: Treasury Sec. Bessent and Larry Kudlow participate in a fireside chat at G20 meeting — 9/1/26
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and host Larry Kudlow attribute a booming U.S. economy to President Trump's tax cuts, deregulation, and energy expansion, while detailing aggressive economic warfare and blockades to asphyxiate the Iranian regime.

briefings.title: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won on SK Hynix's massive memory expansion — full interview
briefings.tldr: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won explains that AI's explosive growth is driving massive demand for memory, prompting SK Hynix to invest heavily in fab expansions—including a $720 billion buildout plan—despite severe near-term supply constraints and high "chipflation."

briefings.title: Watch CNBC’s full interview with Palantir CEO Alex Karp
briefings.tldr: Palantir CEO Alex Karp defends the company's "sovereign AI" and open-weight model strategy, arguing that enterprises must retain control of their proprietary data and alpha rather than engaging in a "parasitic" relationship with frontier labs.

briefings.title: CNBC's Sara Eisen moderates a policy panel at the ECB Forum on Central Banking 2026 — 7/1/26
briefings.tldr: At the 2026 ECB Forum, central bank leaders from the ECB, Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Canada signaled a coordinated shift away from rigid forward guidance toward "framework guidance," highlighting divergent regional economic pressures and the massive, hard-to-measure impacts of AI on productivity and financial stability.

briefings.title: The AI Productivity Boom with David Solomon
briefings.channel: The Economic Club of New York
briefings.tldr: While AI will cause near-term job dislocation and require significant labor upskilling, it is poised to unleash a generational productivity and economic growth boom supported by massive capital market liquidity, even as businesses face rising cyber risks and macroeconomic pressures.

briefings.title: AeroVironment CEO on the future of drones and defense
briefings.tldr: AeroVironment is leveraging its massive scale and strategic acquisitions like BlueHalo to lead a paradigm shift in global drone warfare, space-based communications, and stratospheric solar flight while addressing critical military and civilian defense gaps.

briefings.title: Europe’s $14 Billion AI Challenger — Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch
briefings.tldr: Mistral AI is scaling its proprietary European cloud infrastructure to establish strategic digital sovereignty, while deploying "Vibe," an open-source agentic platform designed to bring secure, cost-effective AI automation to global enterprise workflows.

briefings.title: 🎙️ Inside the Next Financial Crisis with Lloyd Blankfein #podcast #theforum
briefings.channel: The Economic Club of New York

people.name: Lloyd Blankfein
people.role: Former Chairman and CEO, Goldman Sachs

briefings.tldr: Lloyd Blankfein warns that a 15-year absence of a major financial reckoning has allowed overvalued, mismarked private assets to accumulate like "dry tinder" awaiting a spark.

briefings.title: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon speaks at Reagan National Economic Forum — 5/29/2026
briefings.tldr: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warns that shifting global geopolitics and domestic bureaucratic inertia are the greatest threats to Western democracy, urging the U.S. to deploy "smart industrial policy" to secure critical supply chains, enact aggressive regulatory reforms to spark GDP growth, and take a decisive stance against foreign adversaries.

briefings.title: Scott Bessent from Beijing - 05/14/26 | Audio Only
briefings.tldr: During a high-stakes summit in Beijing, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent signaled a shift toward establishing formal AI safety protocols and bilateral trade boards with China, while asserting that the U.S. negotiates from a position of strength as an energy superpower and the undisputed leader in artificial intelligence.

briefings.title: ETF Edge on Roundhill's Memory ETF surpassing $6 billion in record time

people.name: Drew Pettit
people.role: Research Director of U.S. Equity Strategy and ETF Strategy, Citi

briefings.tldr: The AI build-out has shifted memory chips (DRAM) from a cyclical consumer commodity to a critical data center bottleneck, driving massive earnings momentum and the record-breaking success of targeted semiconductor ETFs.

briefings.title: Roundhill's DRAM ETF notches $6B on memory demand, here’s their next big idea
briefings.tldr: The massive surge in Roundhill’s Memory ETF (DRAM) highlights that memory chips have replaced processors as the primary bottleneck in the AI buildout, shifting the sector from a cyclical consumer-driven industry to a high-growth secular powerhouse.

briefings.title: “Weapons of Mass Disruption” with NYT’s Tom Friedman - 05/08/26 | Audio Only
briefings.tldr: As military tensions escalate between the U.S. and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz, columnist Tom Friedman warns that the shift from the "Age of Information" to the "Age of Intelligence" necessitates an urgent U.S.-China AI arms control agreement to prevent "weapons of mass disruption" from enabling catastrophic global cyberattacks.

briefings.title: Inside Alts: Warburg Pincus' Perlman on the evolution of private equity

people.name: Leslie Picker
people.role: Senior Finance and Banking Reporter, CNBC

briefings.tldr: Warburg Pincus CEO Jeffrey Perlman advocates for a return to "diversification by design" and a performance-first private partnership model to navigate a "third wave" of private equity characterized by retail wealth participation and structurally higher interest rates.

briefings.title: Novo Nordisk CEO: Open to deals, we need the broadest pipeline in the world
briefings.tldr: Novo Nordisk is leveraging a successful "peptide-in-a-pill" Wegovy launch and strategic rebranding of Rybelsus to maintain a 65% share of new prescriptions, while aggressively pursuing M&A to build the world’s broadest metabolic pipeline.

briefings.title: Property Play: Propy CEO on the blockchain revolution coming for real estate
briefings.tldr: Propy is leveraging blockchain and AI to transform real estate transactions into secure, "on-chain" settlements, reducing closing times from weeks to hours.

briefings.title: Inside Wealth: Thiel Capital Managing Director Jack Selby on investment opportunities
briefings.tldr: While AI is a revolutionary technology, it is forming a massive, capital-intensive bubble where potential losses could be orders of magnitude larger than the dot-com era due to high infrastructure costs and underpriced Middle Eastern geopolitical risks.

briefings.title: Axiom CEO on the frontier in space commerce
briefings.tldr: Axiom Space is positioning itself as the primary successor to the International Space Station (ISS) by integrating three core business pillars—spacesuit development, private astronaut training, and modular commercial infrastructure—to meet a global demand for space access that currently exceeds available supply.

briefings.title: iRocket CEO Asad Malik and Sec. Wilbur Ross on the future of aerospace, drone warfare and espionage

people.name: Wilbur Ross
people.role: Former Commerce Secretary and iRocket investor

briefings.tldr: iRocket is leveraging a fully robotic, AI-driven factory to revolutionize aerospace manufacturing, significantly reducing the "cost to kill" for counter-drone systems and working toward 100% reusable launch vehicles capable of 24-hour mission turnarounds.

briefings.title: ETF Edge on how volatility and conflict in the Middle East are reshaping ETF strategies

people.name: Jamie Harrison
people.role: Head of ETF Capital Markets, MFS

briefings.tldr: Despite prolonged conflict in the Middle East and shifting interest rate expectations, the ETF market remains resilient due to robust market structure; however, investors are increasingly shifting toward energy, hedged equity, and active management to navigate potential "midterm election year" volatility.

briefings.title: ETF shelters from the Middle East War

people.name: Jamie Harrison
people.role: Head of ETF Capital Markets, MFS

briefings.tldr: Despite heightened geopolitical conflict in the Middle East, the ETF market remains remarkably resilient due to robust structural arbitrage mechanisms and a strategic investor pivot toward energy, natural resources, and hedged equity products.

briefings.title: Property Play: Project Destined CEO on the next generation of CRE investors and AI edge
briefings.tldr: Project Destined is a leading real estate education platform that provides diverse students and veterans with "ownership mentality" training and career pathways, currently scaling its impact through a massive integration of AI and data science curriculum funded by major industry partners.

briefings.title: Is Private Credit the Next Systemic Crisis? Steve Liesman Weighs In | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 53
briefings.tldr: While the U.S. economy demonstrates "unforecastable resilience," the combination of opaque private credit markets, potential oil "stock" shocks, and political gridlock at the Federal Reserve creates a high-uncertainty environment that disproportionately threatens lower-income consumers.

briefings.title: Apple built a hardware empire in its first 50 years. The next 50 could be defined by AI.
briefings.tldr: As Apple marks its 50th anniversary, the company is pivoting from its legacy as a hardware-first pioneer to an AI-driven services powerhouse, leveraging a "late mover" strategy by partnering with rivals like Google and OpenAI to revitalize Siri and secure its dominance for the next half-century.

briefings.title: Eli Lilly CEO: Our pill supply can 'reach the planet'
briefings.tldr: Eli Lilly has announced the approval of Foundayo (orforglipron), a once-daily oral GLP-1 pill that leverages small-molecule manufacturing to achieve the massive scale necessary to address the global obesity epidemic.

briefings.title: Property Play: JLL CEO on how global conflicts and capital shifts are reshaping CRE
briefings.tldr: Despite geopolitical volatility and market fears over AI disruption, JLL is seeing a recovery in commercial real estate driven by a "flight to quality" in core assets and significant productivity gains from decade-long investments in proprietary data and AI tools.

briefings.title: ETF Edge on crypto's rebound, the new ETFs to watch and what's different this time
briefings.tldr: Despite ongoing geopolitical turmoil in the Middle East, cryptocurrency is maintaining its role as a strategic portfolio diversifier with low correlation to traditional assets, while the industry shifts from a "crypto winter" toward institutional maturity through new index-based ETFs and regulatory-compliant infrastructure.

briefings.title: Vast CEO Max Haot on raising $500M in new investment round
briefings.tldr: Vast has secured $500M in its first major outside funding round to accelerate the development of Haven-1, a private space station set to launch in Q1 2025 as a primary contender to replace the International Space Station (ISS).

briefings.title: Strikes in Iran and Lloyd Blankfein Looks Back 3/2/26
briefings.tldr: Following the death of Ayatollah Khamenei, the U.S. and Israel have entered a "new and uncertain phase" of conflict in Iran, triggering a de facto closure of the Strait of Hormuz and marking the onset of the world’s first AI-driven hot war.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong and U.S. Senator Bernie Moreno
briefings.tldr: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong and Senator Bernie Moreno are coordinating with the Trump administration to pass comprehensive crypto market structure legislation by April, focusing on "stablecoin rewards" to modernize the U.S. financial system and maintain global dominance over the dollar.

briefings.title: She's the youngest woman to have led a Fortune 500 company and now runs a $100B+ healthcare giant
briefings.tldr: Sarah London, CEO of Centene, applies an athlete’s mindset of individual accountability and "team-first" winning to lead a $100B healthcare giant through industry volatility and digital transformation.

briefings.title: Novo Nordisk CEO on medicare coverage, new obesity pill, U.S. pricing pressure
briefings.tldr: Novo Nordisk expects 2026 to face sales growth headwinds due to U.S. pricing pressures, but aims to offset lower margins through massive volume increases driven by the Wegovy pill launch and expanded Medicare access.

briefings.title: FedEx CEO Raj Subramaniam: We are undergoing a tremendous transformation
briefings.tldr: FedEx is executing a fundamental "One FedEx" transformation to transition from a physical logistics provider to a data-driven supply chain orchestrator, projecting a 13–14% operating income CAGR through 2027 despite modest revenue growth.

briefings.title: Squawk Pod: Fast food economy & America’s AI regulation - 02/12/26 | Audio Only
briefings.tldr: The U.S. economy is currently defined by a "bifurcated" consumer and a concentrated labor market, while a bipartisan House vote to overturn Canadian tariffs signals growing Congressional pushback against executive trade powers.

briefings.title: OpenAI vs. Anthropic, the AI shift that's rattling software stocks and AI Super bowl commercials
briefings.tldr: The AI landscape is experiencing unprecedented acceleration, disrupting traditional software markets and fueling an intense "war" among major AI labs for enterprise, developer, and consumer dominance through increasingly capable, agentic models that empower even non-technical users to build and deploy sophisticated applications.

briefings.title: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
briefings.tldr: ServiceNow reported exceptionally strong financial results and announced a significant $5 billion share buyback, directly addressing and refuting investor concerns that generative AI will disrupt enterprise software.
